articles.headline: Drishyam 3 Reviews: Critics Call the Finale Gripping, Hail Ajay Devgn–Jaideep Ahlawat Face-Off
articles.subheadline: Critics largely praise the final chapter of the Drishyam franchise, with the Ajay Devgn–Jaideep Ahlawat showdown and the climax earning the strongest notices, even as some reviewers flag a slow first half and convenient plotting.
articles.image_caption: The official poster for Drishyam: The Conclusion features Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar alongside Tabu and Jaideep Ahlawat. Critics gave the Abhishek Pathak-directed finale an average of 3.5 stars across 18 published reviews.

articles.headline: 7 Dogs Review: Saudi Arabia's $40 Million Action Spectacle Brings Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt Into a Globe-Trotting Thriller
articles.subheadline: The Saudi-backed action film features a sprawling international cast including Monica Bellucci and Giancarlo Esposito, but critics say spectacle wins over story.
articles.image_caption: Bollywood actor Salman Khan. His latest film 7 Dogs, a Saudi Arabia-backed action spectacle, has generated significant buzz.

articles.headline: Vishal's Directorial Debut 'Magudam' Draws Harsh Reviews From Critics
articles.subheadline: The Tamil action drama, which marks the actor's first film behind the camera, earns a uniform 2 out of 5 stars across major publications despite a 185-minute runtime and a large-scale production.

articles.headline: The Odyssey Review: Nolan's Greek Epic Is a Spectacle Worth the Voyage — Mostly
articles.subheadline: Christopher Nolan's $250 million IMAX adaptation of Homer earns its epic ambitions with a stunning score and strong ensemble, even if some island adventures test your patience.

articles.headline: Festival Darling Max, Min and Meowzaki Finally Hits Indian Theatres
articles.subheadline: Padmakumar Narasimhamurthy's multigenerational dramedy about a Mumbai family, a breakup, and a cat named after Hayao Miyazaki arrives in cinemas after a four-year international festival run.

articles.headline: Jana Nayagan Review: Vijay's Farewell Film Delivers Fan Service and Political Punch
articles.subheadline: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Thalapathy Vijay's swansong blends high-octane action with political messaging, earning mixed-to-positive reviews as a fitting curtain call for the superstar's three-decade career.
articles.image_caption: A still from Jana Nayagan, Thalapathy Vijay's final film released on July 23, 2026. The political action thriller marks the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's farewell to a three-decade acting career.

articles.headline: Vijay's Farewell Film Jana Nayagan Opens to Packed Theaters and Mixed Reviews
articles.subheadline: The Tamil superstar-turned-Chief Minister's final cinematic outing draws massive first-day crowds, but critics remain split on its blend of fan service and political messaging.
articles.image_caption: A still from the official trailer of Jana Nayagan. The political action thriller marks Thalapathy Vijay's farewell to cinema ahead of his full-time career as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister.

articles.headline: Satluj Review: Diljit Dosanjh Delivers a Career-Defining Performance in Banned Punjab Drama
articles.subheadline: Honey Trehan's biographical film about human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra drew 6.58 million views in 48 hours before being pulled from ZEE5 in India. International audiences are driving a 374% surge in app downloads.
articles.image_caption: Diljit Dosanjh, who stars as human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra in the biographical drama Satluj. The film was pulled from ZEE5 within 48 hours of release after government intervention.

articles.headline: Heartstopper Forever Gives Netflix's Beloved Queer Romance a Bittersweet Farewell
articles.subheadline: Alice Oseman's feature-length finale trades fairy-tale warmth for a mature, emotionally honest goodbye to Charlie and Nick — and earns a 95 percent Rotten Tomatoes score in the process.
articles.image_caption: Kit Connor and Joe Locke star as Nick and Charlie in Netflix's Heartstopper Forever, the franchise's finale film (Wikimedia Commons)
